lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A change to your service. A deadline in your inbox. A teammate waiting on an answer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Important things arrive all day. Finding what matters, and keeping everyone up to date, still falls on you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet AI Peer. It knows your work, brings you what matters, and helps your team when you're away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It connects your projects, services, conversations, and decisions. It keeps watch on the sources you allow, with the boundaries you choose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Start your day with a brief built around you.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: First, the dispute feed is changing. It affects your Chargebacks service. I've pulled together the migration guide and the code to review.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Today's data office hours cover results that change later, one of your open checks. I've drafted the question you need answered.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: And the company hackathon opens Friday. The agent track fits your handoff idea. Here's a draft pitch, if you want to take it further.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What matters, and what to do next.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Later, when Manish goes offline, his team still needs context.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Manish, daily totals or each dispute's final result?

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: It's two a.m. for him.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: I am Manish's AI Peer. Each dispute's final result, updated hourly. Here's the requirement.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: Use Dispute Events. It updates hourly. I'll send the new field mapping.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Thanks. I'll add it to his morning brief.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next, a project sync he's delegated to his Peer.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Manish's Peer, what's the Chargebacks status?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: The build is ready. Two checks remain: repeated events, and results that change later.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Sarah's confirmed the hourly source in Slack.

lines.speaker: sarah
lines.text: I'll send both examples.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Can we lock Friday?

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: That's Manish's call. I'll bring him the test plan and the decision.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Morning. The mapping's here, and Sarah's offered the test examples.

lines.speaker: peer
lines.text: Next, follow up on validation, then decide on Friday. Your hackathon pitch is saved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Less time piecing it together. More room for your best work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AI Peer. Your work. A step ahead.
